records.candidate_name: University of Ibadan Political Science undergraduate course structure
records.source_authority: University of Ibadan, Faculty of the Social Sciences
records.source_title: Courses — Political Science undergraduate course structures and descriptions
records.locator: Courses page; B.Sc. Political Science course structures for 100 and 200 level, plus the course descriptions for POS 111, POS 112 and POS 312.
records.evidence: The official University of Ibadan page lists POS 111 The Study of Politics, POS 112 Nigerian Constitutional Development, POS 113 The Organization of Government and POS 114 The Citizen and the State at 100 level, and identifies POS 312 Logic and Methods of Political Inquiry as a compulsory research-methods course.
records.scope: A programme-level learning reference for political institutions, constitutional development and political inquiry; it does not establish a role-specific relationship or imply that every downstream role requires these courses.
